utils.analysis.get_distance_timebins(DLC_config, filepath, binsize, start, end, bodypart, thresh=70)[source]

Get distance/locomotion for a body part from a DLC file

Parameters:

  • DLC_config – config file (can be DLC or pose - used only for “fps”)

  • filepath – path to file of interest

  • binsize – size of timebins (in seconds)

  • start – start time

  • end – end time

  • bodypart – which bodypart to track

  • thresh – threshold for point-to-point distance that should be marked as wrong and excluded

Returns:
